theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_countable_projection_net
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), n ≤ N → 0 < ε → ∃ Q : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Rn N), (∀ j, finrank ℝ (Q j) = n) ∧ ∀ P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ P = n → ∃ j, ‖P.starProjection - (Q j).starProjection‖ < ε
